title: Inter-region failover matrix and upgrade rollback UI for Private Console
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design a console UI that helps operators visualize inter-region connectivity for Private/VPC deployments, simulate failover scenarios, and plan safe model/runtime upgrades with automated rollback paths. The feature combines an inter-region connection matrix, live cluster health overlays, an upgrade impact simulator, and a single-pane rollback/mitigation workflow linked to rollout controls.
background_and_problem_statement: Customers running Private clusters across multiple regions currently lack a native console view that explains how traffic will fail over during a region outage or an upgrade. Support tickets show confusion about which clusters are eligible for failover, whether KV cache warmups will survive rollbacks, and how an upgrade might affect cross-region latency and cost. We need a single interface that reduces cognitive load during incidents and planned maintenance.
goals: Provide a clear visual representation of region-to-region connectivity and configured routing policies
Allow operators to run hypothetical failover simulations and see impacted routes, latency, and estimated cost delta
Integrate upgrade scheduling with automatic rollback triggers and a guided rollback UI
Surface per-cluster health and KV cache status to inform safe rollouts
acceptance_criteria: Inter-region matrix shows live status (healthy/degraded/down) for each region pair
Simulation mode overlays affected clusters and produces a downloadable impact report
Upgrade flow offers a staged rollout with canary targets and an explicit rollback path that can be triggered from the same screen
Design includes mobile/responsive considerations for on-call engineers viewing status pages
Prototype validated in a usability session with at least 3 platform engineers and 2 customers
design_notes: Prefer a compact matrix as the primary view with expand-to-map for spatial context. Use colorblind-friendly palette and patterns for degraded states. Add affordances for quick remediation actions (reroute, pause rollout, force rollback). Include explicit explanations of caching and session affinity implications per cluster. Keep cost estimator lightweight — show token throughput delta and approximate per-hour cost impact.
constraints_and_considerations: Must not expose private IPs or sensitive topology details in managed console screenshots
Data refresh cadence should balance telemetry cost; default to 15s for status overlays with user-configurable refresh
Interactions that trigger changes require multi-step confirmation and 2FA for enterprise tenants
Design must work within existing Console design system components and grid
tradeoffs_and_alternatives_considered: Full map-first approach: more intuitive for geospatial ops but less scannable when many regions exist
Text-heavy table with detailed route rules: easier to implement but harder to reason about during incidents
We chose matrix-first with optional map expansion to optimize for quick triage and scalability
decision_log: 2026-02-25: Opted for matrix-first layout after design critique — majority voted for scanability under incident conditions
2026-03-04: Agreed to include KV cache state APIs from runtime team; eng to add /api/v1/kv/cache-status endpoint
2026-03-10: PM requested addition of a downloadable impact CSV for customer-facing runbooks
review_feedback: PM (Lina Chen): Add explicit cost estimate line for scheduled upgrades and show sample worst-case token surge
Eng (Daniel Park): Need to confirm telemetry payload size; prefer delta updates over full payloads to save CPU
Security (Priya Rao): Ensure screenshots omit BGP/ASN-level details and sanitize topology identifiers
risks: Overloading the UI with too many controls may confuse on-call users; prioritize read-first interactions
Incorrect cache-state assumptions could lead to unsafe rollouts — require gating by runtime-sourced signals
Real-time telemetry could increase the customer's egress/billing if not rate-limited

Hand off annotated spec to eng (ENG-46210) for API contract and telemetry budget planning
